caribbean.headline: Roatan Braces for Heavy Rain, Moderate Winds
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing 27 kt winds, 5.6 ft waves, 8 s swell from the east, and 88% rain probability. Barbados sees 14 kt winds and no significant rainfall.

mediterranean.headline: Venice Faces 12 kt Winds, 2.2 ft Waves, Heavy Rain
mediterranean.paragraph: Venice is experiencing 12 kt winds and 2.2 ft waves, with 100% rain probability, and I see that Mykonos will have 20 kt winds. The swell period is 4 s from the ENE, and wave heights remain modest across the region.
